title: AutoPay Rate Points on a Temporary Rate Reduction Plan
content:
**Rule.** For a Temporary Rate Reduction Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan with AutoPay enrolled, with at least one AutoPay debit posted and none returned in the twelve months before the offer date, takes 0.25 percentage points off the plan rate; a loan with AutoPay enrolled and at least one returned AutoPay debit in those twelve months takes 0.10 points off; any other loan, including one enrolled with no AutoPay debit posted in those months, takes none, a debit counting as within them when fewer than twelve whole calendar months separate its date from the offer date. Enrollment and AutoPay debits are read from the loan's Personal Loans record and payment ledger.

## Truth table (within the twelve months)

| AutoPay enrolled | AutoPay debit posted | AutoPay debit returned | Points off the plan rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | at least one | none | 0.25 |
| yes | any | at least one | 0.10 |
| yes | none | none | none |
| no | any | any | none |

*Hypothetical edge:* offer date 12 November; a debit dated 13 November of the previous year is within the twelve months, one dated 12 November of the previous year is not.
